The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the cognizance order dated
25.01.2023, charge sheet dated 18.10.2022 as well as the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.517
of 2023, arising out of Case Crime No. 0267 of 2022, under Sections-498A, 323, 506, 324 I.P.C. and
Section 3/4 of Dp Act, 1961, Police Station- Kotwali Dehat , District- Bijnor, pending in the court of
Addl, Civil Judge (Jd), Court No.2/JM, Nagina, Bijnor.

court of

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have reconciled their differences and compromise have entered between them which has been reduced in writing.
Applicant No.1 is husband of opposite party No.2.
Compromise deed has been filed as annexure 3 to the affidavit.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no. 2 does not dispute the correctness of the facts.
5. Accordingly, it is provided that the parties shall appear before the court below along with a certified copy of this order on the next date fixed.

It is therefore expected that the trial court may fix a date for the verification of the compromise entered into between the parties and pass an appropriate order to that effect within next four weeks.
It shall be open to the applicants to file a fresh application U/S 482 at that stage for the relief sought herein.
6. In view of the above, the present application is disposed of.
7. For a period of five weeks, no coercive measure shall be taken against the applicants.

Order Date :- 16.12.2023 Nitin Verma  Akleem And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99707357/
